No. The local Stage 3 work does not address item 2b.

Evidence:

- The uncommitted Stage 3 work currently contains the performance harness and design document, but no production changes.
- `BatchSessions` still calls `writeSessionToSubdirectory` → `writeTranscript` → `writeCompactTranscript` in [persistent_batch.go](/Users/muskanpaliwal/Work/open-source/entire/cli/improve-process-sessions-condensation/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/persistent_batch.go:197).
- The first compaction remains in [persistent.go](/Users/muskanpaliwal/Work/open-source/entire/cli/improve-process-sessions-condensation/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/persistent.go:1018).
- Stop finalization still compacts the transcript again in [persistent.go](/Users/muskanpaliwal/Work/open-source/entire/cli/improve-process-sessions-condensation/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/persistent.go:1963).

Stage 3 reduces `process_sessions` from multiple checkpoint builds and commits to one batch operation. It does not reuse the compact transcript between the checkpoint write and Stop finalization. After Stage 3, each Stop would still perform both full compaction passes.

Item 2b therefore needs a separate fix or must be added explicitly to the Stage 3 scope.
